select from project order by created_at desc

select from project where bu_id = #{buId} order by created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into project (id, code, name, customer, bu_id, owner_id, stage, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{customer}, #{buId}, #{ownerId}, #{stage}, coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update project set code = #{code}, name = #{name}, customer = #{customer}, bu_id = #{buId}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, stage = #{stage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
